inputs.configured_context: Positive integer explicitly configured for the request, or null.
inputs.serving_context: Positive integer observed from the serving runtime, or null.
inputs.advertised_context: Positive integer reported as model capacity, or null.
inputs.fallback_context: Positive fallback integer; an invalid fallback resolves to the contract default of 4096.

effective_context.selection: Select the smallest positive configured, serving, or advertised value. Equal values prefer serving, then configured, then advertised. If no valid value exists, return fallback_default.

errors: Boolean, non-integer, zero, and negative metadata values are ignored as absent.
Advertised capacity alone is medium confidence and must not enable a hard request gate.
Unknown metadata uses a low-confidence fallback and must not be presented as a verified limit.

compatibility.additional_output_fields: Consumers ignore fields they do not require.
compatibility.hard_limit_rule: Only serving and configured selections are hard limits in v1.
